grains.RAW.PROCESSING_LINES: one food processing line per ID; 24 synthetic lines (seafood cooking, poultry chilling, ready meal packing, blast freezing) in six Thai plant cities, with HASH-seeded age, type, deviation propensity, shift and sanitation verification profile
grains.RAW.CCP_READINGS: one line-day per ENTITY_ID and EVENT_DATE; daily CCP aggregates, not individual sensor packets
grains.RAW.VERIFICATION_KITS: one required verification kit type per line at snapshot date
grains.CURATED.PERFORMANCE_SUMMARY: one line over the entire 90-day observation window
grains.CURATED.TREND_ANALYSIS: one day over all lines in the plant network
grains.ML.DEVIATION_RISK_SCORES: one line scored on its latest observation day
grains.RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY: one CCP reading (simulated) loaded by Snowpipe or APP.SIMULATE_TELEMETRY
grains.ML.ATP_ANOMALIES: one line-day in the last 15 days, scored against the prior 75-day baseline

line_availability_pct.note: OPERATING_HOURS are production hours not on CCP hold

hours_between_deviations.zero_deviations: null; not an infinite or zero estimate

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day plant-network CCP hold hours FORECAST; ATP swab ANOMALY_DETECTION per line (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.LINE_SOP_SEARCH over 15 synthetic CCP deviation SOPs (one per line type and deviation cause)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: semantic view APP.FOOD_SAFETY_ANALYTICS (CCP deviations sum to the KPI) and Cortex Agent APP.FOOD_SAFETY_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; action memo by Cortex AI_COMPLETE (Snowflake build) or Amazon Bedrock Claude via external-access UDF APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE (AWS build)
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (line count, daily availability, CCP hold hours by line, deviation risk, IoT message count) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: IoT Core rule -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_TELEMETRY
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_ALARM_ALERT logs new ALARM readings to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)
required_capabilities.deviation_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of a CCP deviation in the next 7 days, evaluated on an out-of-time holdout against the base rate
